items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Ben was with Andy Kirk but Ben was trying to get me to go with Basie.

ctx.x: Was Ben in the band too?

No, Ben was with Andy Kirk but Ben was trying to get me to go with Basie. And I said, "No, I can't play with this band." That band had destroyed me, Milt. I said I can only play about 5 or 6 pieces; I can't play with that band.
